overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed opening-of-school operations and enrollment, appointed a new Director of Administration and Finance, and heard reports on science curriculum frameworks and district summer and extended-day programs.

items.title: Recognition of Team Medford School Supply Drive
items.summary: The committee recognized Team Medford for donating $27,000 worth of school supplies to district teachers and elementary students.

items.title: Opening of School and Enrollment Report
items.summary: Superintendent Belson presented an update on district opening operations, enrollment figures, staffing, and class sizes, which the committee voted to place on file.

items.title: Report on Administrative Meetings and Teacher Induction Week
items.summary: Deputy Superintendent Nelson summarized the four-day new teacher induction program and summer administrative sessions, and the report was placed on file.

items.title: Report on Science Education Curriculum Frameworks
items.summary: Science Director Rocco Cieri detailed the state's 2016 science and technology framework updates and district curriculum alignment plans, and the committee placed the report on file.

items.title: Report on Before-School Program
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Caldwell reported on enrollment and operations for the elementary before-school program, and the paper was placed on file.

items.title: Report on After-School Program
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Caldwell provided an operational update on the elementary after-school programs, which was accepted and placed on file.

items.title: Report on Summer Programs
items.summary: Deputy Superintendent Nelson outlined summer special education, ELL, computer science, and vocational offerings, and the report was placed on file.

items.title: Report on New Cleaning Service Contract
items.summary: Finance Director Velie presented the RFP evaluation process that led to selecting Prospect Building Services for district janitorial services, and the report was placed on file.

items.title: Appointment of Director of Administration and Finance
items.summary: The committee voted unanimously to appoint Kirsteen Patterson to a two-year contract as Director of Administration and Finance.

items.title: Selection of Delegates to MASC Fall Conference
items.summary: The committee discussed delegating members to the upcoming MASC Fall Conference and voted to table the selection to the next meeting.

items.title: Resolutions and Announcements
items.summary: The committee passed condolence resolutions for several former educators and community leaders, observed a moment of silence for 9/11, and highlighted upcoming school events.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding negotiations and legal matters.
